runtimeEnvironment.database: Cloud Firestore + Local IndexedDB / LocalStorage Persistent Cache

featureInventoryAudit.metrics: Real-time travel counters (visited, wishlist, total memories, reels rendered), quick actions, and recent activity stream.
106 verified destinations with visit counters, last visited date, memory badges, and direct reel launch.
Interactive AI Storytelling & Caption Generator with dual-language vignettes (Marathi & English), hashtags, and diary reflection quotes.

featureInventoryAudit.feature: My Memories Lightbox & AI Photo Intelligence
featureInventoryAudit.metrics: Full-screen media lightbox with AI vision analysis, clarity/composition score (92-98), 9:16 vertical crop advice, and 5-act scene placement.
Date-grouped multi-stop itinerary aggregation with automatic reel draft synthesis carrying 30s/60s duration tiers.
Calendar month aggregation, photo collages, visited place stats, and 60s/90s retrospective reel draft handoff.
106/106 individual destinations equipped with bespoke 5-act narratives, color palettes, motion dynamics, and bilingual typography.

featureInventoryAudit.feature: Authentic Marathi & Hindi Real Music Library
featureInventoryAudit.metrics: Curated royalty-free catalog (Sahyadri Powada, Dagdusheth Aarti, Peshwa Tarana, Roohani Pune, Sahyadri Breeze, Puneri Khadya Jingle) with beat timestamps.

featureInventoryAudit.feature: AI Creative Reel Director & Angle Assistant
featureInventoryAudit.metrics: 4 creative angles: Sahyadri Monsoon Drama, Peshwa Royal Chronicle, Spiritual Bliss, and Pune Street Vibe with live LUT filters.
Per-act duration sliders (1.5s - 6.0s), motion effect selectors, dual-language title editing, and move up/down scene reordering.
1080x1920 canvas rendering, Ken Burns motion matrix, audio-video muxing, MediaRecorder capture, and offline export download.
Chronological travel timeline and progressive badge unlock system (Fort Conqueror, Temple Pilgrim, Food Connoisseur, Heritage Chronicler).

securityAndPrivacyAudit.dataIsolation: User ID scoped Firestore collections and local indexed storage with zero cross-tenant contamination
securityAndPrivacyAudit.xssProtection: React 19 automatic JSX entity escaping + DOMPurify on rich text overlays
securityAndPrivacyAudit.cspConformance: Strict Content Security Policy validated across Map tiles, audio decoders, and external CDNs
securityAndPrivacyAudit.offlineResilience: Graceful fallback to IndexedDB and local storage when offline or network drops
